title: Digital Health Interventions for Clients Display Values
description: Display values for Digital Health Interventions for Clients ValueSet codes. Generated from FHIR expansions. Keys are code fragments (the part after '#' in the canonical IRI). The full IRI can be reconstructed as system + '#' + code.
